name: whatsapp-business-agent-skills
tagline: Work with WhatsApp Business through Whatsable and its MCP server
description: One skill that connects an AI agent to the Whatsable MCP server and teaches it WhatsApp's rules: the 24-hour window, template approval, the AI agent and human handoff, and number-bound access. It does every task the server supports and guides the person through the rest of the Whatsable app.
author: whatsable

env.name: WHATSABLE_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. A Whatsable API key, for agents that cannot sign in with OAuth. An owner or an admin creates it under API keys.
